Subject: Field Ambassadors: Office-hours series + co-marketing plan

Hi Rita / Alex —

Thanks again for the intro last week. Following up with a concrete idea we discussed on the call: Redwood + BrightLayer co-running a regional "Field Ambassadors" office-hours series for ISV and platform partners. Short overview attached (RL-field-ambassadors-onepager.pdf) but key points below: 

- Format: 45-minute live office hours (30 min demo/Q&A + 15 min partner spotlight)
- Cadence: biweekly (6 sessions across Apr–Jun), rotate host between organizations
- Audience: practitioner-focused (developer/solutions engineers, partner PMs) — ~50–100 registrants target per session
- Joint deliverables: blog post recap (blog swap), shared promo (email + Twitter + LinkedIn), short post-event Loom highlight
- Sponsorship ask: co-branded email send + shared ad credit for event registration; optional paid booth at SummitX in June (we can help coordinate)

Attachments: RL-field-ambassadors-onepager.pdf, draft_agenda.xlsx

Would BrightLayer be interested in committing 2 speaker slots and co-promoting? If so, can you confirm primary speaker and preferred weeks (we have Apr 10, Apr 24, May 8, May 22, Jun 5, Jun 19 as candidates)? Also any logo / brand guidelines you need us to follow?

If this looks good I’ll loop in Demand to book the event pages and set up the shared Drive folder.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
